evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies HTTP server initialization and RPC bind logic in src/httpserver.cpp.
rationale: Prevents local RPC credential leakage and node takeover by failing closed when IPv4 loopback binding fails. Under previous behavior, if IPv4 binding failed but IPv6 succeeded, 'the server fails open and generates a cookie file', transmitting plaintext cookie credentials from bitcoin-cli to a rogue local process on IPv4 and allowing an attacker to 'commandeer bitcoind over IPv6'.
